report:
SEAT B, fresh independent non-author read-only review. Actual runtime model: claude-opus-4-8 (honest; both 4.8 and 5.5 are authorized by USER-BOTH-OPUS-RULE.md and ROOT-CURRENT-SCOPE.json). One vote; same-provider context is not provider diversity. Nothing executed/imported/compiled/hashed/dispatched; no private capture, raw stream, provenance path, auth, key, wallet, SRS or cache read. All runtime statements are source-level predictions. The proposal is NOT accepted; neither author metadata object is a vote; history is not rewritten. realExportReady is false always because a corrected unit, an actual ordinary unit result, a second agreeing audit and a root decision must still happen.

READ ROUTE. MANIFEST.json, SEGMENT-INDEX.json, then READ-SEGMENT-01..12 in order and complete, carrying all 20 bodies: CURRENT-READER, PROPOSED-READER, PROPOSED-UNIT, PROPOSED-PATCH, PROPOSED-POLICY, ORIGINAL-AUTHOR-PROCESS, ORIGINAL-AUTHOR-WHOLE-OBJECTS, B-WHOLE-OBJECTS, B-PROCESS, B-TASK, B-OUTPUT-SCHEMA, PUBLIC-DIFFERENCE, SINGLE-REVIEW-A, SINGLE-PROCESS-A, USER-BOTH-OPUS-RULE, OFFICIAL-HEADLESS, OFFICIAL-STRUCTURED-OUTPUTS, OFFICIAL-SOURCES, STRUCTURED-OUTPUTS-SOURCE, ROOT-CURRENT-SCOPE. I examined actual source lines, not the comment/policy narrative.

WHAT IS SOUND. (ER01) The change is minimal and additive: PROPOSED-READER.py:3-66 add one pure function; PROPOSED-READER.py:71-98 add the new branch. The new flag implies export-only (PROPOSED-READER.py:72) and the branch raises SystemExit (PROPOSED-READER.py:98) before the dispatch else, so a provider is never dispatched; the normal and ordinary --export-only paths match CURRENT-READER.py line for line. (ER02) The selector takes exactly result.structured_output on the single success result (PROPOSED-READER.py:196-201), consistent with OFFICIAL-STRUCTURED-OUTPUTS.md:57 (validated data on the result), :390 (success without structured_output is a failure) and :381 (fallback can retract mid-stream); the recursive whole-stream walk is deliberately unused, so quoted/nested/text copies cannot override the typed object. Authority selection vs unique judgment is cleanly separated (PROPOSED-POLICY sec 4; receipt records legacyRecursiveWholeObjectCount and legacyReaderRecordPreserved). The private-envelope contract (uniqueness of structured_output; origin of B's second object) is correctly NAMED as a gap, not read or assumed. (ER05) EXPORT requires exact reviewToken (PROPOSED-READER.py:203), frozen-schema validation (PROPOSED-READER.py:205-206) and membership of the typed object among retained whole candidates (PROPOSED-READER.py:210-215); no splice/partial/convenient-vote/text fallback. The B-I6 case is distinguished correctly: one retained object stores the single character U+0030 while the other stores a literal six-character escape token (reverse solidus, letter u, 0, 0, 3, 0), which produce different canonical serializations, so membership does not conflate them. (ER06) Two new files only, via exclusive-create open('x') (PROPOSED-READER.py:245,247) with a pre-existence guard (PROPOSED-READER.py:230); the branch returns before any existing record is written, so PROCESS/REVIEW/AMBIGUOUS/WHOLE are preserved; a partial write fails closed on re-run. (ER07) The helper is pure (json+jsonschema only, no I/O); the unit AST-extracts exactly the one FunctionDef and exec's that single node (PROPOSED-UNIT.py:70-79) with json+jsonschema, never importing or running the module/dispatch/private logic; no cache/network/provider/native path. (ER09) Bounded envelope and correct gating: authored-not-run, one ordinary unit only after two agreeing audits plus a root decision, author no vote. (ER10) No automatic real export, B-vote admission, security correctness, adoption, or native work from any pass; receipt sets sourceGreenExecuted=False, nativeAuthority=0, and leaves B's multiplicity STOP open.

WHAT MUST BE FIXED. (ER08, highest) PROPOSED-UNIT.py cannot reach the asserted all-20 GREEN. test_reject_no_actual_assistant_frames calls _stream(assistant_models=()) and _stream evaluates assistant_models[0] at PROPOSED-UNIT.py:99 and :102, raising IndexError before the selector runs; unittest reports 1 error. Moreover, because _stream always appends two assistant frames carrying a model, the NO_ACTUAL_ASSISTANT_MODEL_FRAMES branch (PROPOSED-READER.py:189) is unreachable from this fixture even if the index were guarded. Predicted outcome: 19 pass, 1 error, not GREEN; the proposal's EXPECTED GREEN claim and the author objects' all-20 claim are false. Fixtures are also derived envelopes, not the actual public B/A whole objects or the real OUTPUT-SCHEMA. (ER04) The hardcoded exclusive 5.5 gates (PROPOSED-READER.py:178 and :190) conflict with the new both-models authorization. The selector's identity mechanism itself is correct (it counts only top-level typed assistant frames, PROPOSED-READER.py:184-188, never quoted/nested metadata, matching providerMetadataQualification). But as written the tool will STOP any authorized actual-4.8 run. It is acceptable only for the exact current actual-5.5 M-HASH B/A export scope; general use under the new rule requires a reconciled, parameterized allowed-model set or a documented 5.5-only-by-design scope plus a model-compatibility source. Separately, ORIGINAL-AUTHOR-WHOLE-OBJECTS asserts session identity Opus 5.5 while ORIGINAL-AUTHOR-PROCESS records actual claude-opus-4-8:30; that self-identity claim is not honest to its own frames and must never be relabeled or adopted. (ER03) The result/type/success/multiple-result/exit branches fail closed (PROPOSED-READER.py:191-206), but the new terminal path omits the --export-only live-PID/status recheck (contrast PROPOSED-READER.py:102-105) and relies solely on recorded exitCode==0; it also silently drops malformed capture lines via except ValueError: pass (PROPOSED-READER.py:237) with no parseErrors accounting. These should be added or explicitly justified for the exact scope.

OWNER-RESOLVABLE LABEL ITEMS. The receipt describes membership as byte-identical but it is canonical-JSON (sort_keys) equality (PROPOSED-READER.py:210) - behaviorally correct, wording imprecise. The receipt does not pin before/after hashes of the pre-existing records or the schema/source; immutability rests on exclusive-create plus early exit, with verification left to root per the gating model. retained defaults to None inside the pure selector (membership skipped) but the wrapper always supplies a list, and the unit exercises the None path at PROPOSED-UNIT.py:224.

VERDICT. ER01, ER02, ER05, ER06, ER07, ER09, ER10 AGREE. ER03, ER04, ER08 NEEDS_FIX. Restricted 5.5-only mode is acceptable for the exact current actual-5.5 M-HASH B/A scope but not as a general tool under the both-models rule. sourceReady is withheld pending the ER04 model reconciliation and the ER03 liveness decision; ordinaryUnitReady is false pending the ER08 unit correction. realExportReady false always. M-HASH and all 20 UTxO families, ACTUS/DeFi/finance, PCD/recursion, private handoff, multi-parent composition and real Preprod remain OPEN; native authority 0.

findings.evidence: PROPOSED-UNIT.py:99 and :102 build the nested tool_use and quoted-text frames using assistant_models[0]; test_reject_no_actual_assistant_frames (PROPOSED-UNIT.py:193-194) passes assistant_models=() via _stream, so assistant_models[0] raises IndexError (tuple index out of range) during fixture construction, before _select/_load_selector. unittest reports this as 1 error.
findings.requiredFix: Make _stream build the DRAFT-carrying nested/quoted frames without indexing an empty tuple (guard, or omit those frames when assistant_models is empty), so the empty-assistant case actually reaches the selector.

findings.evidence: Even if F1's index is guarded, _stream unconditionally appends two assistant frames carrying a model (PROPOSED-UNIT.py:99-103); the selector counts any top-level assistant frame with a recognized model (PROPOSED-READER.py:184-188), so assistant_models would never be empty and PROPOSED-READER.py:189 NO_ACTUAL_ASSISTANT_MODEL_FRAMES is never exercised.
findings.requiredFix: For the no-actual-frames case, construct a stream that contains NO assistant frame with a recognized model (drop or de-model the nested/quoted frames) so the branch is genuinely tested.

findings.evidence: PROPOSED-READER.py:178 rejects any requested model other than claude-opus-5-5 and PROPOSED-READER.py:190 requires exclusive actual claude-opus-5-5; USER-BOTH-OPUS-RULE.md authorizes both 4.8 and 5.5. The gate would STOP authorized actual-4.8 runs. B/A M-HASH subjects are actual 5.5 (B-PROCESS.json, SINGLE-PROCESS-A.json), so the gate is acceptable only for that exact scope.
findings.requiredFix: Reconcile explicitly: either parameterize the allowed-model set (and update rules 2/5 and the PROPOSED-POLICY gating wording of 'actual Opus 5.5 audits') to honor the both-models rule, or document the tool as 5.5-only-by-design for the exact current scope and add a model-compatibility source before any broader use.

findings.evidence: The terminal-review branch (PROPOSED-READER.py:73-98) reads PROCESS.json and passes rec.get('exitCode') to the selector but does not perform the live-PID/status recheck the ordinary --export-only path performs at PROPOSED-READER.py:102-105; it relies solely on a recorded exitCode==0.
findings.requiredFix: Add the same liveness/status recheck on the terminal path before trusting the capture, or document why a recorded terminal exitCode==0 is sufficient given no dispatch and exclusive-create output.

findings.evidence: PROPOSED-READER.py:236-237 parses capture lines with except ValueError: pass, silently discarding malformed lines on the terminal path with no parseErrors accounting (unlike the legacy walk loop).
findings.requiredFix: Record a count of skipped/malformed lines in the receipt, or justify silent skipping; confirm a dropped line can only cause a STOP, never a wrong EXPORT.

findings.evidence: Membership uses json.dumps(obj,sort_keys=True) canonical equality (PROPOSED-READER.py:210-213) but the receipt/policy call it byte-identical to a retained candidate.
findings.requiredFix: Label it canonical-serialization (sorted-key JSON) equality rather than byte identity; behavior is correct and distinguishes the B-I6 variants.

findings.evidence: The receipt (PROPOSED-READER.py:244 update) records legacyReaderRecordPreserved and inputPinsUnchanged but no before/after sha256 of the pre-existing PROCESS/REVIEW/AMBIGUOUS/WHOLE records or of the schema/source; immutability rests on exclusive-create plus early exit.
findings.requiredFix: Either pin before/after hashes of the pre-existing records and schema in the receipt, or keep that verification explicitly as a root precondition/postcondition in the gating record.

findings.evidence: ORIGINAL-AUTHOR-WHOLE-OBJECTS report claims the session initialised as Opus 5.5, while ORIGINAL-AUTHOR-PROCESS.json records assistantEnvelopeModelCounts claude-opus-4-8:30 and ROOT-CURRENT-SCOPE confirms actual 4.8:30.
findings.requiredFix: Preserve the actual-4.8 record; never relabel the author output as 5.5; neither author metadata object is a vote or adoption.

findings.evidence: PROPOSED-UNIT uses derived UNIT_SCHEMA/CANON/DRAFT (PROPOSED-UNIT.py:42-67) modeled on the public B objects, not the actual public B/A whole objects or the real OUTPUT-SCHEMA.
findings.requiredFix: The future bound run should bind the real OUTPUT-SCHEMA and the public B/A whole objects (and only those) before any claim beyond the single scoped unit.

assessments.evidence: Additive only: selector at PROPOSED-READER.py:3-66 and new branch at :71-98; new flag implies export_only at :72 and raises SystemExit at :98 before the dispatch else, so no provider is dispatched. Normal and --export-only paths match CURRENT-READER.py line for line; PROPOSED-PATCH.diff shows exactly two hunks with the remainder unchanged.

Selector takes result.structured_output on the single success result (PROPOSED-READER.py:196-201), consistent with OFFICIAL-STRUCTURED-OUTPUTS.md:57,381,390; recursive walk unused on this path. Authority-selection vs unique-judgment separated (PROPOSED-POLICY sec 4); the private-envelope contract is named as a gap (sec 7), not read or assumed.

Result/type/success/multiple-result/exit branches fail closed (PROPOSED-READER.py:191-206, selector rules 3/6/7/8), but the terminal path omits the live-PID/status recheck present at PROPOSED-READER.py:102-105 and relies solely on recorded exitCode==0, and silently drops malformed lines at PROPOSED-READER.py:237.

Identity uses only top-level typed assistant frames (PROPOSED-READER.py:184-188), which is correct, but the exclusive 5.5 gates at PROPOSED-READER.py:178 and :190 conflict with USER-BOTH-OPUS-RULE.md; acceptable only for the exact actual-5.5 M-HASH B/A scope. Original author metadata claims 5.5 while its process records actual 4.8:30 and must not be relabeled.

Mandatory exact reviewToken (PROPOSED-READER.py:203), frozen-schema validation (:205-206) and canonical-form membership against retained whole candidates (:210-215); no splice/partial/text fallback/convenient vote. The two B-I6 variants (single char U+0030 vs a literal six-character escape token) serialize differently, so membership does not conflate them.

Pre-existence guard (PROPOSED-READER.py:230) plus exclusive-create open('x') for the only two new files (:245,:247); the branch exits at :249 before any existing-record write, so PROCESS/REVIEW/AMBIGUOUS/WHOLE are immutable; open('x') fails closed on partial/re-run. Receipt does not itself pin pre-existing record hashes (see F7).

select_terminal_structured_review uses only json and jsonschema, mutates nothing and reads no files; PROPOSED-UNIT.py:70-79 AST-extracts exactly the one FunctionDef and exec's that single node with json+jsonschema, never importing/running the module, dispatch, or private logic; no cache/network/provider/native path.

test_reject_no_actual_assistant_frames errors: _stream(assistant_models=()) hits assistant_models[0] at PROPOSED-UNIT.py:99/:102 (IndexError) before the selector; and _stream always appends model-bearing assistant frames so NO_ACTUAL_ASSISTANT_MODEL_FRAMES is otherwise unreachable. Predicted 19 pass + 1 error, not GREEN. Fixtures are derived, not real B/A objects or the real OUTPUT-SCHEMA.

PROPOSED-POLICY sec 5-7 and PROPOSED-UNIT docstring: authored-not-run, bounded effects (one public-file AST read, no writes/socket/new deps/private reads), one ordinary unit only after two agreeing audits plus a root decision, author no vote. Actual readiness is blocked by the ER08 defect, and the 'Opus 5.5 auditors' wording should be reconciled to both-models (cross-ref ER04).

No automatic real export/B-vote admission/security-correctness/adoption/native from any pass; receipt sets sourceGreenExecuted=False and nativeAuthority=0 (PROPOSED-READER.py:244), preserves the legacy record and leaves B's multiplicity STOP open (PROPOSED-POLICY sec 4,7). A valid typed object proves artifact identity only.

recommendation.firstBlockedBoundary: Any ordinary unit verification of select_terminal_structured_review. It is blocked first by the PROPOSED-UNIT.py defect (assistant_models[0] IndexError at :99/:102, making test_reject_no_actual_assistant_frames error and the all-20 GREEN claim false, with the empty-assistant branch otherwise unreachable), and by the unreconciled hardcoded 5.5-only gate (PROPOSED-READER.py:178,:190) versus the both-models rule. Independently it is gated on a second fresh agreeing audit and a root decision. No unit run is authorized here; real export remains further blocked behind an actual GREEN result and a separate root adoption decision.

predictedUnitResult: NOT GREEN. Against the candidate as written I predict 19 of 20 methods pass and 1 errors: test_reject_no_actual_assistant_frames raises IndexError (tuple index out of range) in _stream(assistant_models=()) at PROPOSED-UNIT.py:99 and :102 before the selector runs, so unittest reports Ran 20 tests, errors=1 (not OK). The empty-assistant NO_ACTUAL_ASSISTANT_MODEL_FRAMES branch is therefore never exercised, and would remain unreachable even if the index were guarded because _stream always appends model-bearing assistant frames. Methods 1-9 and 11-20 pass as analyzed. This contradicts the proposal/policy/author 'all 20 pass' GREEN expectation.
